key: The engine still seems to be functional.
en: The engine still seems to be functional.
ja: エンジンは　まだ　動くようだ。
フルスピードで　行きますか?

en: TAKA: Woaaah, okay crazymaker, watch where you're steerin' that thing...
ja: タカ: うわあああ　ちょっと　狂った運転手さん　ハンドル　ちゃんと　見てくださいよ……

key: TAKA: Remind me to never let you drive me anywhere again...
en: TAKA: Remind me to never let you drive me anywhere again...
ja: タカ: 二度と　あなたの運転で　どこにも　行かないって　忘れないように　しないと……

key: Actually, it wouldn't be such a bad end with you.
en: Actually, it wouldn't be such a bad end with you.
ja: というか　あなたと　一緒になら　こんな最期も　悪くないかも。

key: TAKA: You're doing this on purpose, aren't you...
en: TAKA: You're doing this on purpose, aren't you...
ja: タカ: わざと　やってますよね……

key: The engine seems to be wrecked.
en: The engine seems to be wrecked.
ja: エンジンは　壊れているようだ。

key: Something on the tracks is in the way...
en: Something on the tracks is in the way...
ja: 線路に　何かが　邪魔している……

key: The engine seems to have had a short...
en: The engine seems to have had a short...
ja: エンジンは　ショートしているようだ……

key: A stray thought tells you you should probably report this as a bug including a screenshot of where you are right now.
en: A stray thought tells you you should probably report this as a bug including a screenshot of where you are right now.
ja: ふと　これは　バグ報告として　今いる場所の　スクリーンショットと一緒に　報告したほうがいいのでは　という考えが　頭をよぎる。

key: TAKA: By the way, you're out here for a gym battle?
en: TAKA: By the way, you're out here for a gym battle?
ja: タカ: ところで　ここには　ジムバトルのために　来たんですか?

key: Is there really a gym out in this clusterfuck?
en: Is there really a gym out in this clusterfuck?
ja: こんな　めちゃくちゃな場所に　本当に　ジムなんて　あるんですか?

key: Scrapyard train puzzle completion detected from another save file.
en: Scrapyard train puzzle completion detected from another save file.
ja: 別のセーブデータで　廃品置き場の列車パズルが　クリアされた記録が　見つかった。
廃品置き場の列車パズルを　スキップしますか?

key: (To get the items from the area, you will have to reenter on your own later.)
en: (To get the items from the area, you will have to reenter on your own later.)
ja: （このエリアの　アイテムを　入手するには　あとで　自分で　もう一度　入り直す必要が　あります）
